name: @lacspace/feed-reader
description: Read the feeds you follow — parse fetched RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0 (RDF), Atom 1.0 and JSON Feed 1.1 into one normalized shape, autodiscover the feeds a web page advertises, and score each source's health (staleness vs cadence, duplicate/poisoned items, volume spikes, missing fields, fetch error rate) so a large source list prunes itself. Robots.txt respect via @lacspace/robots. The read-side complement to @lacspace/rss. Deterministic, isomorphic, zero third-party dependencies, bring-your-own-fetch.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
